# Copilot repository entry point

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [specs/README.md](../specs/README.md).
Follow the local constitution and specification workflow. **Code Maintenance**
is implemented locally; evidence and remaining release/integration blockers are
linked in the index. Do not restart completed tasks or assume a new feature.
Inspect the source and preserve unrelated changes. Record evidence before marking
tasks complete. Work within this repository and document external-owner handoffs.
